stories.title: 7 bird flu cases across Prairies linked to Saskatchewan poultry show
stories.summary: Seven cases of highly pathogenic avian influenza have been detected in the Prairie provinces after an exposure at a Saskatchewan poultry show earlier this month.

stories.title: 3 exemptions added to new Alberta driver’s licence rules amid renewal headaches
stories.summary: Exemptions will be considered for long-established Albertans with historical document issues, those with 'exceptional hardships' and people waiting on the federal government.

stories.title: Harris returns for another CFL season with Riders
stories.summary: The decision to return for a fifth season with the Saskatchewan Roughriders was a rather easy one for Trevor Harris.

stories.title: Auditor general can’t commit to timeline on Alberta health contract corruption probe
stories.summary: The probe is among multiple investigations launched after the former head of Alberta Health Services in 2025 made allegations of corruption in multimillion-dollar health deals.

stories.title: IIHF says it was the target of a cyberattack, takes website offline
stories.summary: The IIHF said it was investigating the source of the cyberattack and was working to restore its systems. Its platforms would be back online soon, it says.

stories.title: Snowfall warning for southern Alberta with up to 25 cm expected
stories.summary: Environment Canada issued a snowfall warning late Tuesday morning for all of southern Alberta and the Calgary region, with up to 25 cm expected in some areas.

stories.title: Lions make Sankey CFL’s top-paid middle linebacker
stories.summary: The B.C. Lions are rewarding Darnell Sankey for a stellar 2026 season.

stories.title: Recreation funding, ice rental fee increases criticized in Calgary’s proposed budget
stories.summary: The City of Calgary's upcoming four-year budget proposal includes potential increases to ice time fees for youth sports like hockey, figure skating and ringette.

stories.title: Edmonton Elks want ‘City of Champions’ signs to return
stories.summary: The Edmonton Elks are champions again, and they want their city to show it.

stories.title: AGLC given permission to look at selling Play Alberta to new operator
stories.summary: The AGLC is considering selling Play Alberta, a government-owned gambling website launched in 2020, as it weighs its future role in the province’s newly launched iGaming market.
